app_identity.target_audience: Warehouse operators, supervisors, fast-paced environment, wearing gloves, mobile-first operations
app_identity.archetype: The Performance Pro (Elite precision, high visibility)

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Industrial. High legibility, heavy numbers.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Dense but tap-friendly. Mobile-first vertical flow.
spacing_and_layout.scale: Tailwind scale with generous padding on active elements
spacing_and_layout.tap_targets: MINIMUM 48px height for all interactive elements (glove-friendly)
spacing_and_layout.container: w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-zinc-950 text-white relative
spacing_and_layout.navigation: Bottom navigation bar for mobile app feel, sticky bottom.

surfaces_and_cards.implementation: Flat solid surfaces. 1px solid borders (`border-zinc-800`). No soft shadows, no glassmorphism. Use sharp corners or very subtle rounding (`rounded-md` max). Use 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights for active states.

buttons.primary: bg-yellow-500 text-zinc-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-wide hover:bg-yellow-400 active:scale-95 transition-transform h-14 w-full flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-900 border border-zinc-700 text-white hover:bg-zinc-800 h-14 rounded-sm flex items-center justify-center font-bold
buttons.camera: bg-yellow-500 text-zinc-950 rounded-full w-20 h-20 flex items-center justify-center border-4 border-zinc-950 ring-4 ring-yellow-500 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(234,179,8,0.3)] active:scale-90 transition-transform cursor-pointer mx-auto
buttons.danger: bg-red-500 text-white font-bold uppercase hover:bg-red-400 active:scale-95 transition-transform h-14 w-full flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm

forms.inputs: bg-zinc-900 border-b-2 border-zinc-700 focus:border-yellow-500 h-14 px-4 text-lg font-mono placeholder:text-zinc-600 rounded-none w-full outline-none text-white transition-colors
forms.chips: px-4 py-2 border border-zinc-700 rounded-full font-bold text-xs uppercase data-[state=active]:border-yellow-500 data-[state=active]:text-yellow-500 data-[state=active]:bg-yellow-500/10 cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap transition-all

cards.truck_item: border border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-900 p-4 hover:border-yellow-500/50 flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-sm cursor-pointer transition-colors

badges.success: bg-green-500/10 text-green-500 border border-green-500/20 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold
badges.warning: bg-yellow-500/10 text-yellow-500 border border-yellow-500/20 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold
badges.danger: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] uppercase font-bold

views_layout.login: Minimalist tactical dark. Large bold inputs for Admin/Operator. Full-width primary button. High contrast.
views_layout.supervisor_dashboard: Bento grid structure. Summary stats at top (Today's trucks, Complete/Incomplete, Exported/Local) using big monospaced numbers. High contrast status badges.
views_layout.queue: List view with large tap targets. Filterable by status. Prominent 'New Truck Input' floating action button.
views_layout.truck_input: Single-column form. Scanner icon inside the license plate input field. 'Autofill from queue' action. Fast numeric inputs where possible.
views_layout.session_mode: Camera-first UI. Top: Horizontal scrollable chips for categories (Surat Jalan, Pengecekan, dll). Center: Huge Camera CTA button. Bottom: Thumbnail grid of uploaded photos with progress bars overlaid. 'Selesai' (Finish) sticky bottom button across full width.
views_layout.history_and_search: Sticky search/filter header. Stacked cards for trucks showing plate number, timestamp, and visual completion status (e.g., 5/5 categories).
views_layout.truck_detail: Header with metadata. Grid layout for photo gallery grouped by category. Click to open full-screen lightbox.
views_layout.export_retention: List of ready-to-export or destroy datasets. Warning colors (Signal Red) for destruction actions. Data table layout for desktop, stacked cards for mobile.

motion.strategy: Minimal, snappy, immediate feedback. Industrial workers need speed, not flourish.
rules: Buttons must have `active:scale-95` for immediate tactile feel.
Uploading photos should show immediate visual feedback (loading skeleton or progress bar).

accessibility.contrast: Extreme high contrast. Black text on Yellow backgrounds for primary CTAs.
accessibility.interaction: All interactive elements require `data-testid`. Glove-friendly tap areas (>48px height).
accessibility.feedback: Use strong color changes + icons for status (e.g., green checkmark icon + green border for uploaded photo).

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a mobile-first PWA for industrial warehouse truck loading.
Prioritize speed of input. This is a field-operations tool replacing paper.
Use dark mode by default with high-visibility yellow (#EAB308) for primary actions.
Implement Barlow Condensed (or similar heavy sans) for numbers and headers to give a rugged, technical feel.
Do NOT use soft shadows or glassmorphism. Use flat surfaces with sharp 1px borders.
Ensure all tap targets (buttons, chips, inputs) are at least 48px high for glove compatibility.
The 'Session Mode' must feature a massive camera button and scrollable category chips.
Dashboard should utilize a dense but readable grid for supervisor overview.
Use Phosphor-icons or Lucide-react for a clean, technical look.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy (using solid borders and colors instead of glassmorphism for this specific app)
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner components are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx (if using React/Shadcn) or similar implementation for Vanilla JS/PWA.
